description: Approved native PostgreSQL DML through change.propose/v1. target.locator=database, operation=INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, one SET /statement value={statement:{sql,parameters?}}. Positional $1 parameters are JSON scalars. precondition, prior SELECT evidence, read_back and checks are not required. verification is SQL_RESPONSE with paths=[/statement] and may be omitted. The original statement is executed once in a transaction; its confirmed commit, native command tag and affected_rows are returned. RETURNING rows are not delivered by this effect; use database.query when values are needed. The Agent decides business preconditions, before/after queries, snapshots and interpretation. No target database receipt table is required. A lost commit response remains unknown and is never automatically replayed. Database account permissions, resource scope, approval and audit remain enforced. No DDL, transaction commands or multiple statements.
title: database.execute/v1 request
